description: Test file for app package functions related to file accessibility and filtering in Mattermost server, including tests for filtering inaccessible files, getting filtered accessible files, and removing inaccessible content from file slices.

methods.name: TestFilterInaccessibleFiles
methods.description: Unit tests for filtering inaccessible files based on creation time and order.

methods.name: TestGetFilteredAccessibleFiles
methods.description: Unit tests for retrieving accessible files from a list, considering sorted and unsorted inputs.

methods.name: TestIsInaccessibleFile
methods.description: Tests for determining if a file is inaccessible based on creation time.

methods.name: TestRemoveInaccessibleContentFromFilesSlice
methods.description: Tests for removing inaccessible files from a slice and marking them as archived.
